verdict.rationale: Jeeves exposes an MCP server letting external AI assistants/agents query spend, pay vendors, and submit reimbursements 'without opening the Jeeves app,' which enables task delegation to AI — but this is an external assistant connecting via MCP, not a built-in assistant embedded inside Jeeves' own product UI. Missing for 10: evidence of a native, in-app conversational AI assistant that users interact with directly inside Jeeves, and any UX/product screenshots showing in-product delegation rather than third-party MCP clients.
